description: Calibration constants structure for FL-1 DUT Power Board Rev A

Vout_gain.description: Multiplier for DAC→Vout mapping (corrects buck gain error)

Vout_offset.description: Additive offset to Vout setpoint (corrects DAC zero error)

I_gain.description: Multiplier for INA219 current reading (corrects shunt resistance error)

I_offset.description: Additive offset to INA219 current reading (corrects input bias)

V_dac_lsb_mv.description: MCP4728 12-bit DAC LSB voltage at 3.3V VDD: 3300/4096 = 0.806 mV/LSB

I_limit_lsb_ma.description: Current limit threshold DAC LSB in milliamps (depends on comparator divider scaling)
I_limit_lsb_ma.note: At full scale (3.3V DAC), comparator IN- = 3.3V. Scaling via 10k/100k divider gives trip = DAC * (10k/110k) / (Rsense * 100k/110k). Calibrate per-rail.

calibration_procedure.step1: Connect precision DMM to DUT output connector
calibration_procedure.step2: Issue SET RAIL<n> 5.0V; measure actual Vout with DMM
calibration_procedure.step4: Connect precision current source (1A, 2A, 5A); issue SET LIMIT RAIL<n> 10000mA
calibration_procedure.step5: Measure INA219 current vs. actual; fit I_gain and I_offset
calibration_procedure.step6: Write cal constants to EEPROM at 0x20+; set board_state=0xA5; update checksum
calibration_procedure.step7: Issue RUN SELFTEST to confirm calibration accepted
